$comment: People the portal adds on a fresh local database (SEED_FILE=deploy/seed.json in TT-suite/.env).
Fill-missing only: missing people are added without an invite email, and a role is granted only in an app
where the person has no access yet. Roles changed later in the portal or an app are never overwritten.
Roles: lms employee|manager|admin, expense member|approver|finance|admin, kanban member|lead|admin, ams employee|manager|admin, resume recruiter|admin (hidden unless granted).
A Kanban lead needs existing teams: "kanban": {"role": "lead", "teams": ["Platform"]}.
Local only: deploy/build.mjs does not package this file.
employeeCode (optional here): the company employee code; filled in when the person has none, never overwrites one set in the portal.
